test_oracle_review.scope: Complete new harness, all branches inspected. Source extracted from requested checkout as static functions; fixture payload travels via environment data, never interpolated into runnable source. Expected path/settings come from independent fixture data, parsed by stdlib tomllib. Failures require actual nonzero plus explicit marker diagnostic AND byte-identical file. Ordinary balanced repeated registration/unregistration are positive controls. Timeout30s bounds each actual runtime. TemporaryDirectory owns only newly created scratch. Windows-only illegal filename restriction is accurately scoped by Ubuntu CI placement. No credential/network activity and no expected-value rebasing.
